archetypes.name: rebase-state
archetypes.rationale: The change mutates in-progress rebase conflict state before routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the checkpoint conflict loop as a rebase-state machine. Focus on rc transitions, stale CONFLICT_FILES handling, and whether staged trivial files can mask remaining non-trivial conflicts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-portability
archetypes.rationale: The wrapper and harness must remain Bash 3.2-compatible.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell changes for Bash 3.2 portability and set -e discipline. Pay special attention to helper return codes, temp-file reuse, while-read loops, and PATH-injected test stubs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
